events.description: Table Top Time October 6, 2026 5:00 pm - 8:00 pm 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA D&D Campaign MATTER's inaugural, in-house D&D campaign, exclusively written and run by our professional DM, Gaven, is midway through their campaign. More campaigns to come! Wanna get on the list? Email [email protected] for more details! New One Shot! On the 29th, we are adding a second table to Table Top Time when our friend Jack brings his time-travel One Shot, RETRO/KILL. Our resident futurist (Rick) will introduce the concept of Table Top Futuring. RETRO/KILL is a rules-light sci-fi action game where you play as time-traveling punk assassins going after the biggest bastards in human history! Battle drug-fueled fascist militias, eldritch Nazi cults, and bioengineered corporate mercenaries; plan heists to steal future technology from corrupt mega-corporations; and stop Ronald Reagan once and for all. Time is running out, and your Strike Team is the only crew left crazy enough to drop into the past and SAVE THE FUTURE! Keep your eyes on our Instagram for more details. events.title: Silent Book Club at MATTER October 10, 2026 1:00 pm - 3:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Mar…
events.description: Silent Book Club at MATTER October 10, 2026 1:00 pm - 3:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA EVENT TYPE: BOOK CLUB Silent Book Club is a global community of readers and introverts, with more than 500 chapters in 50 countries around the world led by local volunteers. SBC members gather in public at bars, cafes, bookstores, libraries, and online to read together in quiet camaraderie. The Denver branch is gathering at The Shop at MATTER on the second Saturday of the month, 1:00-3:00pm. So grab your book and get ready to cozy up and read in beautiful silence with other members. Bring your own book, e-book, comic, audiobook, zine, textbook, or shop beforehand in our bookstore.

events.description: Making Our Way Back Craft Night October 20, 2026 5:00 pm - 8:00 pm 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205 ✨ Making Our Way Back is an invitation to slow down and return—to yourself, to community, and to the quiet intelligence of your hands. Through simple, hands-on craft, we honor the rhythm of making as a form of care, resilience, and shared knowledge.✨ No experience required—just curiosity and a willingness to show up. Every 2nd Tuesday of the month, 5–8 PM , we gather to slow down, get our hands messy, and explore simple, accessible crafts in a warm, community-centered environment. Each session is guided by a rotating crew of exceptionally talented makers who lead with curiosity—not perfection—so you can experiment freely and find your own rhythm. Grab your Craft Pass Here!! Materials, tools, guidance, and encouragement included. No one turned away due to a lack of funds. Add to Google Calendar See more details

events.title: Author Talk: Breaking Ice, Sonali Kolhatkar on Immigration, Identity, & Belonging October…
events.description: Author Talk: Breaking Ice, Sonali Kolhatkar on Immigration, Identity, & Belonging October 23, 2026 2:00 pm - 4:00 pm The Shop at MATTER, 2114 Market St, Denver, CO 80205, USA We’d love for you to join us for a special afternoon with Free Speech TV host and author Sonali Kolhatkar at The Shop at MATTER in Denver. Sonali will share insights from her book, Breaking Ice, and be joined by an immigration justice activist for a timely and thought-provoking conversation about immigration, the human stories behind today's headlines, and an account of the growing immigration movement. There will also be plenty of time for your questions, conversation, and connection. Following the discussion, Sonali will sign books during an informal reception, where refreshments will be served. The event is free, but space is limited to 50 guests and advance registration is required. When you register, you'll also have the option to purchase copies of Breaking Ice. Your book will be waiting for you at the event, where Sonali will be happy to personally sign it.
